segments.PHM.1.8-9: Paul appeals to Philemon in love instead of giving orders
segments.PHM.1.10-13: Paul sends Onesimus, now useful, back to Philemon
segments.PHM.1.14-16: Paul wants Philemon to receive Onesimus as a brother
segments.PHM.1.17-20: Paul asks Philemon to welcome Onesimus and promises to pay
segments.PHM.1.21-22: Paul trusts Philemon and asks him to prepare a guest room
